payload.text: Each code critic's `agent.md` carries nothing that is wrong for its language (no non-Elixir Diogenes handoff, no description naming `rules/<lang>/`, no stale test line) and says that `intent critic <lang>` is what the commit gate runs; the Diogenes handoff appears in `critic-elixir` alone; `intent claude subagents list` and `critic.rs` agree with the tree.
